payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing corresponding visible closure features of the same woman's jacket in the source and edited images, is there visible progress toward bringing the front panels together, although the jacket is not fully closed?
node.criteria: Pass only if corresponding visible closure features show movement toward bringing the front panels together, while the jacket remains not fully closed. Fail only if those features can be compared reliably and show no such progress. Unknown if pose, occlusion, or draping prevents a reliable comparison; do not infer progress or its absence from pose or silhouette alone.
node.binding: Compare the same woman's jacket in the source and edited images. Focus on visible front edges, their separation, and any fastener or closure area. Account for pose changes only insofar as the same closure features remain comparable; disregard unrelated edits.
